name: tj1 events listener this is the emitter and once removes it
source: import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events'; function main(): void { const e = new EventEmitter(); e.on('a', function (this: any, n: number) { console.log(this === e, n); }); e.once('b', function (this: any) { console.log(this === e); }); e.emit('a', 1); e.emit('b'); console.log(e.emit('b'), e.listenerCount('a')); }
